note: STARTER PLAN, not a settled specification. This is a proposed decomposition of an archetype quiz. Confirm or edit it with the user before the first implementation session. See AGENTS.md > Feature List Rules.

features.name: Verification Baseline
features.description: Choose the stack, add a dependency lockfile, and replace the init.sh placeholder with a real verification command. This is the gate for every other feature.
features.verification: ./init.sh exits 0 and runs at least one real product check (test, type-check, or lint)

features.name: Quiz Content Model
features.description: Define the archetypes and the question set as reviewable data, separate from any presentation or scoring code.
features.verification: Data loads successfully and every question maps to a known archetype

features.name: Scoring Engine
features.description: Turn a complete set of answers into a deterministic score per archetype.
features.verification: Unit tests cover a full answer set, an empty answer set, and a tied result

features.name: Result Resolution
features.description: Resolve scores into one primary archetype plus runner-ups, with an explicit and tested rule for ties.
features.verification: Tie-breaking rule is documented and covered by a test

features.name: Quiz Flow
features.description: Present questions, collect answers, and advance through the quiz to completion.
features.verification: A user can complete the quiz end to end and reach the result step

features.name: Result Presentation
features.description: Show the resolved archetype with its description and a breakdown of the contributing scores.
features.verification: Result screen renders the primary archetype returned by the scoring engine

features.name: End-to-End Verification
features.description: Add Layer 3 verification covering the full path from first question to rendered result.
features.verification: One automated end-to-end run exercises the complete quiz journey

features.name: Result Persistence
features.description: Persist a completed result so it survives a restart, and define what happens on a re-take.
features.verification: Result survives restart; re-taking the quiz is handled per the documented rule
